title: Kates KafkaReference v1alpha1
description: A reference architecture for a Kafka platform on Kubernetes. kates compliance check reports every declared constraint the live cluster does not meet.

apiVersion.description: The compliance schema version. Must be conformity.kates.io/v1alpha1.

kind.description: The document kind. Must be KafkaReference.

metadata.description: Reference metadata identifying this compliance profile.

name.description: Unique DNS-label name for this reference architecture (e.g., prod-3az, minimal).

description.description: Human-readable summary of the reference architecture and its target environment.

spec.description: Declared architectural, sizing, placement, durability, security, and monitoring rules.

target.description: Optional cluster identity pins. When set, kates compliance check verifies it is inspecting the intended cluster.

platform.description: Kubernetes operator platform managing the Kafka cluster.

namespace.description: Expected Kubernetes namespace of the Kafka custom resource.

name.description: Expected metadata.name of the Strimzi Kafka custom resource.

clusterId.description: Expected 22-character base64url Kafka cluster ID reported by status.clusterId.

zoneLabel.description: Kubernetes node label used to determine availability zone spread and skew.

versions.description: Version constraints for Kubernetes, the Strimzi operator, and Kafka. Always quote version strings (e.g., "4.2.0") so YAML does not parse 4.10 as 4.1.

controllers.description: Sizing, storage, and topology placement constraints for KRaft controller pods.

dedicated.description: Whether controllers run in dedicated controller-only node pools without the broker role.

brokers.description: Sizing, storage, and topology placement constraints for Kafka broker pods.

kafka.description: Kafka-level rack awareness, authorization, listener security, and broker configuration rules.

source.description: Where config and rackAwareness read from: cr, the Kafka CR (no Kafka access), or brokers, the Kafka Admin API (each broker's effective values). A setting, not a rule.

rackAwareness.description: Whether broker rack awareness (spec.kafka.rack or broker.rack) is enabled.

authorization.description: Required Kafka authorization mechanism (none, simple, opa, keycloak, or custom).

listeners.description: Constraints on Kafka listeners declared in spec.kafka.listeners.

require.description: Named listeners that must exist on the cluster with the specified type, port, TLS, and authentication.

every.description: Universal constraints that every declared Kafka listener must satisfy.

type.description: Allowed listener exposure types across all listeners.

tls.description: Whether TLS encryption must be enabled on every listener.

auth.description: Allowed authentication mechanisms across all listeners.

config.description: Broker config name to constraint. With source cr, compared with what the Kafka CR sets, and a key it leaves out fails; with brokers, with the effective value on every broker.

topics.description: Each topic's own durability, internal topics included. Read through the Kafka Admin API whatever kafka.source says, so declaring it opens a Kafka connection.

replicationFactor.description: The smallest replica set across the topic's partitions.

minInsyncReplicas.description: The topic's effective min.insync.replicas: its own, or the broker default.

exclude.description: Topic-name prefixes left out, such as __ for Kafka's internal topics. Prefixes, not patterns.

monitoring.description: Observability and Prometheus metrics export rules.

metrics.description: Required metrics reporter configuration (none, jmxPrometheusExporter, or strimziMetricsReporter).

kafkaExporter.description: Whether the Strimzi Kafka Exporter deployment is enabled.

podMonitor.description: Whether Prometheus Operator PodMonitor resources exist for the cluster.

waivers.description: Time-bounded exceptions for declared rules that are temporarily allowed to fail without failing the compliance check.

dnsLabel.description: A lowercase RFC 1123 DNS label (1..63 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens).

severity.description: Rule violation severity: fail (exits 1) or warn (reported without failing the check).

operatorShape.description: equals and oneOf stand alone; min and max combine. A map without an operator is refused.

count.description: A non-negative integer count between 0 and 10000.

intConstraint.description: An integer constraint: either a bare integer for exact equality, or a map with equals, min, max, or oneOf and optional severity.

port.description: A TCP port number between 1 and 65535.

portConstraint.description: A TCP port constraint: bare port number or map with equals, min, max, or oneOf.

quantityConstraint.description: A Kubernetes resource quantity constraint (e.g., "8Gi", {min: "4Gi", max: "32Gi"}).

version.description: A dotted version, as a string. Missing parts count as 0: 4.2 is 4.2.0.

versionConstraint.description: A dotted version constraint with quoted version strings (e.g., {min: "4.0.0"}).

stringConstraint.description: An exact string or set of allowed strings.

boolConstraint.description: A boolean constraint: bare true/false or {equals: true/false, severity: warn}.

storageType.description: Strimzi storage topology type: ephemeral, persistent-claim, or jbod.

antiAffinityLevel.description: Pod anti-affinity enforcement level: required (hard), preferred (soft), or none.

storageTypeConstraint.description: Constraint on storage type (ephemeral, persistent-claim, or jbod).

antiAffinityConstraint.description: Constraint on pod anti-affinity (required, preferred, or none).

authConstraint.description: Constraint on listener authentication (none, tls, scram-sha-512, oauth, or custom).

authorizationConstraint.description: Constraint on broker authorization (none, simple, opa, keycloak, or custom).

listenerTypeConstraint.description: Constraint on listener exposure type (internal, cluster-ip, route, loadbalancer, nodeport, or ingress).

metricsConstraint.description: Constraint on metrics exporter (none, jmxPrometheusExporter, or strimziMetricsReporter).

configConstraint.description: min and max compare numbers; equals and oneOf compare the value's text, so false matches "false".

resources.description: Container CPU and memory resource constraints.

role.description: Common sizing, storage, and topology placement constraints for a node role (controllers or brokers).

count.description: Number of pod replicas required for this role.

requests.description: Kubernetes container resource requests per pod.

limits.description: Kubernetes container resource limits per pod.

storage.description: Persistent or ephemeral volume storage constraints per pod.

type.description: Storage topology type (ephemeral, persistent-claim, or jbod).

size.description: Total persistent storage capacity per pod (e.g., {min: "500Gi"}). Cannot be combined with type: ephemeral.

class.description: Kubernetes StorageClass name required for PVCs. Cannot be combined with type: ephemeral.

zones.description: Number of distinct availability zones (by spec.zoneLabel) across which pods of this role must be spread.

skew.description: Maximum allowed difference in pod count between the most-populated and least-populated availability zone (typically {max: 1}).

perNode.description: Maximum number of pods of this role scheduled onto any single Kubernetes worker node (typically {max: 1} or 1).

antiAffinity.description: Pod anti-affinity enforcement configured on the role's scheduling template (required, preferred, or none).

requiredListener.description: One rule: the listener exists with every property listed. Its severity is the rule's, so its properties take no warn of their own.

name.description: Listener name in spec.kafka.listeners (1..11 lowercase alphanumeric chars, e.g., plain, tls, external).

tls.description: Whether TLS encryption must be enabled on this listener.

auth.description: Required client authentication mechanism on this listener.

waiver.description: A time-bounded exception for a single declared rule ID.

rule.description: Exact rule ID declared in this file (e.g., brokers.count, kafka.listeners[external], kafka.config[min.insync.replicas]).

reason.description: Explanation of why this rule is temporarily waived and the remediation plan.

by.description: Owner, team, or ticket approving the waiver.

until.description: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format (max 365 days ahead).
